other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Odisha.
Must possess identity and residential proof including an Aadhar card.
Must have a bank account in the applicant's name in Odisha.
Must have requisite land free from all encumbrances.
Pond area must be between 0.2 and 2.0 hectares with a minimum water depth of 6 feet.
Previous beneficiaries of similar subsidies are eligible for additional subsidies up to a total of 2 hectares.
benefits_summary: Provides a 40% subsidy for the general category and a 50% subsidy for SC/ST/Women on tank construction and input costs, with subsidies ranging from ₹56,000 to ₹4,25,000 depending on pond size.
